method:
After timing+sizing each build tool, boot its emitted bundle headlessly in jsdom (a fresh child process per tool, reusing the linker-smoke e2e Step-4 boot pattern) and assert: (a) bootstrap throws NO JIT / "@angular/compiler not available" error, and (b) the routed component renders into the DOM (an

Linker smoke

). A fast build that ships broken output is flagged works:"FAIL", never rewarded.
